name: Vampire Knight
description: At Cross Academy, two student disciplinary committee members are tasked with keeping the peace between a human class and a night class of vampires.

videos.title: Vampire Knight: Portrait of Passionate Love
videos.overview: Aidou has the idea to hold elections for Moon's Dorm president. The candidates are Kaname and the current president Ichijou. Who will win?

videos.title: Night of Vampires
videos.overview: Cross Academy has two sessions, the Day Class and the Night Class; the latter consists of students who are beautiful, intelligent ... and vampires!

videos.title: Memories of Blood
videos.overview: Yuki is busy patrolling the school grounds for Day Class girls who are trying to sneak chocolates to the Night Class boys for St. Xocolatl’s Day.

videos.title: The Fang of Penitence
videos.overview: When Zero suddenly leaves the school grounds, Yuki goes after him and roams the streets alone, until a mysterious mother and child appear before her.

videos.title: Trigger of Condemnation
videos.overview: Seeing the state Yuki is in, Kaname takes her from Zero, who is speechless when he realizes what he has done. Yuki cries, unaware of Zero’s secret.

videos.title: Moonlight Festivities
videos.overview: A new ethics teacher arrives at Cross Academy. His atypical looks are all the buzz among the Day Class; even Zero has lost his usual composure.

videos.title: Their Choices
videos.overview: Zero is tempted to sink his fangs into Yuki, and even though he's able to regain his composure, he finds himself the target of a teacher.

videos.title: The Scarlet Maze
videos.overview: Yuki makes a decision regarding Zero, who is determined to fight his affliction until the very end. Yuki feels guilty for betraying Kaname.

videos.title: Gunshot of Sorrow
videos.overview: There's a commotion in the Moon dormitory when the Night Class gets word that Takuma’s grandfather, a figure in the vampire world, will be visiting.

videos.title: Crimson Gaze
videos.overview: Day Class students are chasing after the Night Class due to the upcoming dance. Meanwhile, the Headmaster asks Yuki to show a transfer student around.

videos.title: The Princess of Darkness
videos.overview: Zero tutors Yuki for an exam, but all the while something is wrong with him. Meanwhile, at the Moon dormitory, Kaname confronts Maria in his room.

videos.title: Consequence of Desire
videos.overview: Maria’s masked servant reveals himself as a jealous figure from Zero's past whom Zero has not seen since their separation long ago.

videos.title: Vow of the Pureblood
videos.overview: Yuki learns Maria's true identity. With this new information, Yuki accepts a deal to offer her blood in order to save Zero.

videos.title: Crimson Chains
videos.overview: Shizuka suffers a wound. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find out where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero's constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures.

videos.title: Burden of Sinners
videos.overview: After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. But when Zero returns, the vampires of the Senate accuse him of murder.

videos.title: The Eternal Promise
videos.overview: Yuki has a lot on her mind after almost being kissed by Zero. She asserts that she will not speak to Kaname until he admits to Zero’s innocence.

videos.title: The Azure Portrait
videos.overview: The Night Class goes to the Aido family’s vacation home during the long break, but Hanabusa decides to stay at the academy to investigate Kaname.

videos.title: Devil's Awakening
videos.overview: While the Night Class is at the Aido family’s vacation home, Yuki, driven by her desire to stop hurting Zero, tries to regain her memory of the past.

videos.title: The Subordinate's Trap
videos.overview: Yuki is continually haunted by visions of blood. Nevertheless, she is determined to find out about her past from Kaname.

videos.title: The Fake Lovers
videos.overview: Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment.

videos.title: The Kiss of Thorns
videos.overview: Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.

videos.title: Spiraling Recollections
videos.overview: Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother and her brother.

videos.title: Revival of the Mad Emperor
videos.overview: Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him -- but he simply can't accept what she has become.

videos.title: Prelude to the Battle
videos.overview: The Headmaster calls for an emergency evacuation of the Day Class students, as Rido’s servant vampires begin attacking the students.

videos.title: Two Souls
videos.overview: In order to protect the academy, the Headmaster confronts the head of the Hunter Society while Rido is still on the rampage.

videos.title: World's End
videos.overview: Yuki decides that as Guardian, she must protect all the students at the academy and fight Rido.

videos.title: Vampire Knight
videos.overview: All of Zero’s strength is not enough to kill Rido -- he will need Kaname's help. But the fight will leave Cross Academy devastated.
